capabilities: Expand and collapse a note's forward and back links recursively
Toggle between forward and back link display
Filter the tree by pathname in a search box
Show note content as nothing, one line, or full text
Edit note text inline and save changes back to the note
extras: The README states the plugin will not work without Dataview installed first, and the author asks readers for financial support for further development.
intentEvidence: combining the structure of outliners like Dynalist & WorkFlowy with the flexibility of Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's backlinks view is a flat list, so there is no way to walk a note's link network hierarchically like in outliner apps.

relations.evidence: This plugin requires the Dataview plugin to function, as it uses the Dataview API
WorkFlowy's design inspired the look for the plugin.

summary: Outliner-style view that shows a note's links and backlinks as a recursively expandable, filterable tree with inline-editable note text.
